jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Onion production manual

varieties.name: Red Creole
varieties.supplier_notes: Standard Kenyan red onion; pungent, stores 3-4 months.

varieties.name: Texas Grano
varieties.supplier_notes: Larger bulb, milder; better for fresh market not long storage.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seed thinly in raised nursery bed at 1cm depth.
Plough and level land. Incorporate 2 tons well-rotted manure per acre.
timeline_template.description_sw: Lima na sawazisha shamba. Changanya tani 2 za samadi iliyooza.

timeline_template.description_en: Transplant 6-8 week seedlings at 10cm x 15cm. Trim roots and tops by 1/3.
timeline_template.description_sw: Pandikiza miche wiki 6-8 nafasi 10cm x 15cm. Punguza mizizi na ncha.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100kg DAP at planting, well-mixed into soil.
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 100 za DAP wakati wa kupanda.

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed carefully — onion roots are shallow.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwa mkono kwa makini — mizizi ni juujuu.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for thrips at first sign of silvery streaks.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya thrips ukianza kuona michirizi yenye rangi ya fedha.
Dosi ya pili ya CAN wakati kitunguu kinaanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Stop irrigation 2 weeks before harvest to cure bulbs.
timeline_template.description_sw: Acha kumwagilia wiki 2 kabla ya kuvuna.

timeline_template.description_en: Pull bulbs when tops fall over and yellow. Cure in shade 1 week.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuta vitunguu majani yakianguka. Hifadhi kivulini wiki 1.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: 50g+ firm bulb, dry neck. Grade B: 30-50g. Reject soft or sprouted.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 50kg mesh bags for wholesale; 10kg net bags for retail.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Dry well-ventilated shed at 0-5°C lasts 6 months. At room temp, 2-3 months.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Banda kavu lenye hewa 0-5°C miezi 6. Joto la kawaida miezi 2-3.
